Transition from Classic Automation to the Agentic AI Era

Operating in more than 50 countries globally and serving approximately 11,000 enterprise customers, UiPath is making a significant change in its automation strategy. The company is accelerating the transition to a new model called “Agentic Automation” by expanding traditional task automation processes.

This new approach aims not only for defined tasks to be performed by robots, but also for more complex processes to be managed with AI-supported orchestration. According to UiPath’s vision, the new enterprise AI model is based on the integration of the following components:

  • AI Agents: Autonomous digital assistants with decision-making capability.
  • Software Robots: Classic RPA bots that handle repetitive tasks.
  • Human Collaboration: Inclusion of the human factor in process supervision and complex decision mechanisms.
  • Single Orchestration Layer: Synchronized management of all these components from a single center.

With this transformation, UiPath aims to enable businesses to integrate AI technologies more deeply into their operational processes and increase efficiency.
